candidates.description: These tokens represent Spanish prepositions and prepositional phrases used to indicate time, location, means, or cause.
The vector represents the concept of riding or surfing on a board, reflected in multilingual and morphological variations of related terms.
This vector represents the concept of variety, variance, or things that are diverse and distinct.
This vector represents common suffixes and letter combinations found at the endings of words or names.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the Germanic or Romance root/morpheme related to "fund," "mouth," "world," or "bottom" (such as *Mund*, *fund*, *Imp*, and *mundo*).
This vector represents frequently used Spanish adjectives and nouns related to common descriptions and concepts.
This vector represents Spanish adjectives and verbs associated with variety, distinction, and practical application.
This vector activates on tokens containing the letter sequence "un" or variations of the Spanish words "un", "una", and "punto".
This vector activates on Spanish grammatical suffixes, inflectional morphemes, and morphologically complex word fragments.
This vector activates on words, names, or subwords containing the letters "u" or "gu" across various languages.
